capabilities: Render headings and lists as a mind-map tree
Rearrange card hierarchy without rewriting Markdown
Apply per-word highlight styles to bold text
disambiguation: Not an integration with the Mubu app; it renders Markdown notes as a Mubu-style mind map inside Obsidian.
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README; notes that maps over 1,200 nodes may render slowly.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a note's headings and lists as a draggable, zoomable mind map while leaving the Markdown source untouched.

relations.evidence: Turn a Markdown note into a Mubu-style mind map inside Obsidian

summary: Markdown mind-map viewer that turns headings and lists into a Mubu-style tree with draggable cards, per-word highlights, and zoomable tables and images.
